title: Sing-Flare-Auto belongs on your radar
description:
This repo should be on your radar: zzzhhh1/Sing-Flare-Auto. 本项目提供了一个基于 Docker 容器的轻量级、高隐匿性科学上网节点部署方案。通过集成 sing-box 和 cloudflared，你可以轻松地在各类云平台（如 Koyeb、Render 等）或个人 VPS 上一键构建安全隧道。下方是详细的视频教程链接：. It has about 581 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/zzzhhh1/Sing-Flare-Auto

#GitHub #OpenSource #Developer #Programming #Shorts
